pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal regions with smooth pixel gradients at the edges. Geometry is primarily non-angular with rounded vertices and high spatial density relative to the background.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light cream-colored pathways forming a topological graph. Junctions are predominantly tri-radial. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the visible mid-flank section.
